description: This Java class 'BankingServiceImpl' implements banking operations such as customer management, account handling, fund transfers, and transaction retrieval within a banking application. It uses Spring Framework annotations for dependency injection and transaction management, and interacts with repositories for database access.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of banking services including customer management, account operations, fund transfers, and transaction history. It interacts with repositories and uses helper methods for domain-entity conversions.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all customers and maps them to domain objects.

methods.name: findAllAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of all accounts in a serializable domain object form.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Adds a new customer based on provided customer details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds a customer by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer information with new details.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer identified by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Finds an account by account number, returning detailed account info.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account for a specified customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Transfers funds between accounts for a specific customer, handling concurrency and transaction records.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves all transaction details for a given account.
